Accept callback-state deferral: the common constructor runs before a conditional on_match_start assignment; the local else path does not clear the callback. Its initialized value requires additional helper evidence.

Accept all four Game Over deferrals. Shared processing includes retry, stock restoration and saved-state selection. Finalization requests menu only when no challenger is selected and gm_80173754 returns zero. Stronger time-helper interpretations remain unverified.
Accept transition-side-effect deferral: a false common processor result suppresses this callback's explicit transition, but does not prove that the processor left the next state unchanged.

Accept Luigi qualification fact and link deferrals. The callback tests integer frame_count / 60 <= 60 after common processing, without a Luigi-only guard. This is not a strict under-one-minute test, and the complete unlock consequences require consumer evidence.

Accept numeric encounter and item deferrals. The adjacent intro names Ness, but the fight roster uses 0x0B; the callback writes item bit 7 and xB = 4 while explicitly leaving item identity unknown. Rendered Ness naming cannot independently prove the mapping or Onett/Mr. Saturn interpretations.

Accept Giga qualification deferral: x78 is latched on stock equality before common result processing, without an outcome guard or mismatch clear. Successful completion without stock loss is a stronger unsupported interpretation.

Accept saved-form provenance deferral. The Team Kirby intro substitutes Sheik when Zelda and nonzero x12 are observed; this consumer does not establish a starting-form-toggle origin. Shared preparation and direct-entry fallback remain supported, while external table contents and reset lifetimes remain deferred.
